title: ceriops australis
intro: Ceriops australis, commonly known as the River Mangrove or Australian Mangrove, is a species of mangrove tree that is native to Australia. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ceriops australis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
